thread:
Sam (PM): Quick sync: drafting a 'lite' DP recruitment + standby protocol. want something low-friction we can repeat monthly.
Izzy (Research): thumbs up. recommend target cohort 15, standby 10. prioritize diversity of infra (hosted, dedicated, private).
Rory (Eng): needs: one feature-flag per partner, 4 reserved concurrent slots, and a fast revert path. can we keep canary to 3 partners for 48h?
Priya (Design): onboarding kit should be a single page: access, canonical prompts, how to report issues. I'll make a one-pager and a short video. :movie_camera:
Lane (Ops): I'll build the standby CSV template and consent checkbox. also propose an auto-email for last-minute fills.
Sam (PM): acceptance criteria for progression: eval delta <10% on smoke set, zero P1s, partner satisfaction survey median >=6. if any single item fails -> hold. two failures -> rollback.
Izzy (Research): smoke set = 8 prompts (3 safety checks, 5 quality checks). I'll provide threshold numbers by Thu. also include an open feedback slot per partner.
Rory (Eng): runbook snippet for rollback:```bash
redwood deploy rollback --env dp-cohort --to-tag stable --reason "dp rollback"
```
NotifyBot: Canary policy updated: 20% -> 60% -> 100% with auto-hold on custom-eval or error spikes.
Priya (Design): partner-facing note draft: "Thanks for joining — setup takes ~15min. Reach out in-thread for help." will share link to doc.
Lane (Ops): logistics: will seed standby list with customers from previous cohorts first, then outreach. CSV and invite copy by Wed.
Sam (PM): owners: Priya = onboarding doc, Izzy = evals, Rory = infra/runbook, Lane = invites/CSV. I'll own the overall calendar. Kickoff Friday 10am PT.
Priya (Design): noted. I'll include a quick troubleshooting FAQ.
Rory (Eng): ack. I'll post the revert command in #runbooks.
Sam (PM): perfect — short and repeatable. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
NotifyBot: Event scheduled: "DP Lite: Recruitment + Standby Kickoff" Fri 10:00 PT.
